#### `isScheduled()`

Determine if the post is scheduled, meaning its date is set in the future.

Scheduled posts are treated as drafts and are skipped during auto-discovery.

Since Hyde is a static site generator, a scheduled post does not publish itself when its date passes. It is included in the first site build that is run after that point, so recurring builds are needed for a post to go live on its own, for example through a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow.

```php
$page->isScheduled(): bool
```
